nri-world.excerpt: When an NRI sells property in India, the buyer must deduct tax at source under the non-resident rules no matter who the buyer is — there is no Rs 50 lakh threshold and no basic-exemption adjustment for the seller. travel.excerpt: A network disruption at CSMIA on Tuesday evening hit check-in, e-gates and DigiYatra for over an hour: 18 of 44 departures between 7 pm and 9 pm left at least an hour late and three were cancelled.
travel.nri_angle: For diaspora travellers connecting through Mumbai's Terminal 2 or starting long-haul journeys there, the outage is a reminder to check airline status before leaving, allow manual check-in time, and carry offline booking copies when DigiYatra is down.

travel.title: Deepavali in Singapore: Little India's 2km Light-Up, Festival Village and What to Do Before Nov 8
travel.excerpt: Serangoon Road's lights run nightly until November 29, the Campbell Lane Festival Village closes on Deepavali itself, and the Indian Heritage Centre's Open House, diya painting and free concerts fill the final week.
travel.image_caption: Performers stage a street performance in Little India during the Deepavali season in Singapore. More than 2km of lights run along Serangoon Road nightly until November 29, and the Festival Village stays open until Deepavali on November 8.
travel.nri_angle: Singapore's Little India runs one of the largest Deepavali celebrations outside India, and this guide gives diaspora readers the exact dates, hours and free events to plan around before November 8.

carousel.title: Chrome Can Now Pull Booking Codes and Order Numbers From Your Gmail
carousel.excerpt: Google's Gemini-powered enhanced autofill suggests flight bookings, tracking numbers and order details from your inbox as you fill forms — US-only, opt-in, and easy to switch off.
carousel.nri_angle: Frequent US-India travellers are among the heaviest users of flight booking codes and tracking numbers the feature is built to surface.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

steps.detail: Use the three-dot menu, then Settings.
Select Enhanced autofill inside that section.

steps.step: Turn off 'Find and fill with Gemini'
steps.detail: This stops Gmail-based suggestions while leaving regular autofill intact.
In Gemini settings, under Connected Apps, disconnect Gmail to stop Gemini reading your mail at all.
